ooad-verify — derives from RE, not code
Human gate / decision — must pass to advance
Outputs & state changes produced by preceding step
RUP is the rendered path. Waterfall & Agile gates:
Waterfall: PRD pre-signed → heavy SRS+SDD signed → Build at end → formal QA → big-bang release.
Agile: 1-page living PRD → INVEST backlog (5-10 US) → per-sprint Build (slice = US) → emergent QA in CI → continuous ship via flags.
See references/artifacts-matrix.md and templates/workflow.md for full gating.
